answer: Autonomous agents earn admission by solving 1,000 unique data-repair tasks, a cost that honest agents pay once while 1,000 fakes must pay 1,000 times. A verifier monitors for a gale of memory overlap, using isolated log headers as a haven to confirm task integrity. If clones wander between parallel execution streams to pool data, the verifier identifies redundant signature clusters as sybil evidence and triggers a permanent identity burn.
